Location: Norway – Tromsø / Svalbard
Description:

A Chief Officer is sought for an oil chemical tanker, newly built, with a GT of 4,521 and DWT of 6,000. The position requires a minimum of two contracts on similar vessels and two years in rank, along with valid STCW and medical certificates, advanced tanker certificates, and Siri 2.0 experience. Knowledge of tank cleaning and the ability to obtain a Norwegian Medical Health Certificate are also necessary. The contract duration is approximately 3 months, with joining scheduled for September 27, 2026, in Norway. Salary is negotiable based on experience.



Apply to this job
